summary: SOC_UAT-018_APPR � Eligible � 3 Pax Mixed Exception (1 Elderly + 2 None) � Delay Code 66 (Crew) � Booker Basic Member � Accommodation Above Threshold Only
title: APPR � Eligible � 3 Pax Mixed Exception (1 Elderly + 2 None) � Delay Code 66 (Crew) � Booker Basic Member � Accommodation Above Threshold Only
description:
Verify APPR Standards of Care (SOC) eligibility, accommodation capping, and automated Interac/EFT payout for a 3-passenger booking with mixed exception profiles (1 Elderly booker with Basic Aeroplan status + 2 Regular non-members) experiencing a 7-hour controllable crew delay (Code 66), where a single accommodation receipt ($620.00 CAD) is submitted above threshold and automatically capped at the policy limit ($500.00 CAD) without manual intervention.

Prerequisites:
Regime: APPR
Itinerary: Single segment � AC 301 YYZ ? YVR
SOC Segment (per SoC Flight Identifier): AC 301 YYZ ? YVR
Promised Itinerary: AC 301 YYZ ? YVR, Dep: 15-Jun 08:00
Actual Itinerary: AC 301 YYZ ? YVR, Dep: 15-Jun 15:00
Departure Delay: 420 min (7 hours)
Departure Delay Code: 66 (Flight Crew Shortage / Scheduling) � Controllable
Controllability: Controllable (Code 66)
Passenger Count & Types (3 Pax on PNR):
Pax 1 (Claimant / Booker): Elderly Adult (Age >= 65) / Aeroplan Basic Member
Pax 2: Regular Adult (Non-exception) / Non-member
Pax 3: Regular Adult (Non-exception) / Non-member
Check Order:
Exception Check ? Mixed Exception (1 Elderly + 2 None) ?
Controllability ? Controllable (Code 66) ? ? ELIGIBLE
PAX Count: 3 adults / Class: PY / Revenue: YES / ACR: No / Journey: > 72h
Overnight Eligible: YES (delay > 360 min)
ENTITLEMENTS (3 adults, PY, 1 Elderly + 2 None, no ACR):
Hotel: Rate of day, 3 nights max, $500.00 CAD cap per room
Meals: $30.00 / pax * 3 = $90.00 CAD
Transport: $200.00 CAD
Communication: $30.00 / pax * 3 = $90.00 CAD
Parking: $50.00 CAD
Essentials: $30.00 / pax * 3 = $90.00 CAD
Submitted Expense: Accommodation only � 1 receipt of $620.00 CAD (1 night luxury/family room, Above $500.00 cap)
